instruction: Cinematic film still, low-angle medium shot looking up. In a high-rise office, the woman in the black blazer (R1) stands on the left in profile, looking towards her colleague. On the right, the man in the dark suit jacket and pink shirt (R2) stands in profile, looking back at her. They are shaking right hands in a firm clasp. The background consists of large windows with closed horizontal blinds. Bright daylight filters through the blinds, casting a soft, cool light over the scene with a professional, corporate mood.
elements: R1 contributes her right hand to the firm clasp with R2
R2 contributes his right hand to the firm clasp with R1
R1 and R2 face each other in profile while maintaining the contact
R1 and R2 are the two participants in the right-hand clasp
closed horizontal blinds cover the large office windows in the background
